title: Pasta with Fresh Tomato Sauce
procedure:
Cook the tomatoes in the oil over high heat until they collapse.
Add the garlic, salt and a pinch of sugar once they soften.
Finish with basil or rosemary and toss the drained pasta through.

title: Spaghetti Aglio, Olio e Peperoncino
procedure:
Warm the sliced garlic and chili gently in the oil; do not brown them.
Drain the spaghetti a minute early and finish it in the pan with its water.
Toss hard so the oil and water emulsify, then add the parsley.

title: Pasta alla Norma
procedure:
Fry the eggplant cubes until deep gold and drain them.
Simmer the passata with the garlic for 10 minutes.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, fold in the eggplant, grate over the ricotta salata.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
procedure:
Render the bacon slowly until crisp and keep the fat.
Beat the eggs with the parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
Off the heat, toss the drained pasta with the bacon, then the eggs, loosening with pasta water.

title: Pasta al Ragu
procedure:
Soften the diced carrot, celery and onion in the oil.
Brown the mince hard, then deglaze with the wine.
Add the passata and simmer at least 90 minutes, topping up with water.
Dress the pasta in the pan with a ladle of its cooking water.

title: Tuna and Cherry Tomato Pasta
procedure:
Burst the cherry tomatoes in oil with the garlic over high heat.
Add the drained tuna and break it up; season.
Toss the drained pasta through with a splash of its water and the parsley.

title: Pasta with Smoked Tofu and Eggplant
procedure:
Sear the diced smoked tofu until the edges crisp, then set it aside.
Brown the eggplant in the same pan, adding oil as it drinks it.
Pour in the passata with the garlic and simmer 10 minutes.
Return the tofu, then toss the pasta through with basil.

title: Pasta with Chickpea Cream and Confit Tomatoes
procedure:
Confit the cherry tomatoes with oil, garlic and thyme in a low oven or air fryer, 25 minutes.
Blend the chickpeas with a little cooking water and oil into a loose cream.
Warm the cream in the pan, toss the pasta through it, top with the tomatoes.
Grate over lemon zest -- it lifts the whole plate.

title: Pasta with Cauliflower Miso Cream
procedure:
Roast or boil the cauliflower until fully soft.
Blend it with the miso, garlic and a little pasta water into a cream.
Sear the diced smoked tofu separately until crisp.
Toss the pasta through the cream; finish with the tofu and toasted walnuts.

title: Baked Pasta with Zucchini Pesto
procedure:
Make a light bechamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Blend half the zucchini with the pine nuts and parmesan into a pesto.
Saute the rest of the zucchini, the peas and the green beans with garlic.
Fold everything through half-cooked pasta and bake 20 minutes at 200 C.

title: Bulgur with Zucchini, Peas and Lemon
procedure:
Cook the bulgur in salted water or stock and let it stand covered.
Saute the diced zucchini hard, adding the peas at the end.
Fold everything together off the heat with lemon zest, juice and mint.

title: Pasta alla Genovese with Seitan
procedure:
Brown the seitan pieces, then set them aside.
Add the sliced onions with the carrot and celery and a splash of water.
Cook covered for an hour, stirring, until the onions melt; deglaze with the wine.
Return the seitan, cook 15 minutes more, then dress the pasta with it.

title: Mushroom Risotto
procedure:
Sear the mushrooms hard in a dry pan first, then set them aside.
Soften the onion, toast the rice, deglaze with the wine.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time for about 18 minutes.
Off the heat, beat in the butter and parmesan and fold the mushrooms back in.

title: Minestrone
procedure:
Sweat the diced carrot, celery and onion in the oil.
Add the rest of the vegetables and the tomatoes, cover with water, simmer 30 minutes.
Blend a ladleful and stir it back in for body.
Cook the pasta in the pot and add the beans for the last five minutes.

title: Chickpea Hummus Tart with Caramelised Onion
procedure:
Boil the carrots, then blend them with the chickpeas, walnuts and almonds.
Caramelise the sliced onion and pepper slowly with the sugar; no vinegar.
Spread the hummus over the pastry, top with the onions and peppers.
Bake 30 minutes at 190 C, until the base is cooked through.

title: Cannellini and Cherry Tomato Tart
procedure:
Blend the cannellini with oil, salt and a splash of water into a thick cream.
Soften the sliced onion in a pan until sweet.
Spread the cream on the pastry, scatter over the onion and halved tomatoes.
Bake 30 minutes at 190 C and finish with thyme and oregano.

title: Pea and Leek Tart with Lemon Zest
procedure:
Sweat the sliced leek until soft and sweet.
Blend most of the peas into a cream, keeping some whole for texture.
Spread over the pastry, top with the leek, bake 30 minutes at 190 C.
Grate the lemon zest over once the tart is out of the oven.

title: Pesto, Green Bean and Potato Tart
procedure:
Boil the potatoes and beans until just tender, then drain them well.
Spread the pesto over the pastry.
Lay the sliced potato and the beans on top and season.
Bake 30 minutes at 190 C.

title: Lentil and Radicchio Tart with Walnuts
procedure:
Blend the cooked lentils with the soy sauce, rosemary and walnuts.
Fry the radicchio hard with the vinegar, sugar and salt until it collapses.
Spread the lentil cream on the pastry and top with the radicchio.
Bake 30 minutes at 190 C. Caramelised onions on top work well too.

title: Chickpea and Caramelised Leek Tart
procedure:
Blend the chickpeas into a thick cream with oil and salt.
Cook the sliced leek low and slow until it caramelises.
Assemble on the pastry and bake 30 minutes at 190 C.

title: Potato, Chard and Olive Tart
procedure:
Boil the sliced potatoes until just tender.
Wilt the chard with garlic and squeeze it dry.
Layer both over the pastry with the olives and bake 30 minutes at 190 C.

title: Potato, Leek and Kale Soup
procedure:
Sweat the leek, add the diced potato and the stock, simmer 20 minutes.
Blend the chickpeas smooth and stir them in.
Add the shredded kale and cook five minutes more.

title: Mediterranean Soy Strips with Eggplant
procedure:
Sear the strips until browned on both sides and set them aside.
Cook the eggplant in the same pan until soft.
Add the tomatoes, garlic and oregano and simmer 10 minutes.
Return the strips and cook them through in the sauce.

title: Cannellini-Stuffed Zucchini
procedure:
Halve the zucchini and scoop out the centres; chop the flesh.
Mash the beans with the softened onion, the zucchini flesh and the herbs.
Fill the halves, top with breadcrumbs and nutritional yeast.
Bake 25 minutes at 200 C until the top is crisp.

title: Sticky Marinated Tempeh
procedure:
Boil the tempeh 10 minutes in water with soy sauce, garlic and ginger.
Marinate it in soy sauce, garlic, curry, lemon, ginger and maple syrup.
Crisp it in a pan or air fryer.
Thicken the leftover marinade with a little flour and pour it back over.

title: Golden Soy Chunks
procedure:
Rehydrate the chunks in hot stock, then squeeze them dry.
Fry them in the oil without moving them, so they colour.
Add the rosemary, pepper and garlic powder and keep frying until golden.

title: Tofu Kebab with Yogurt Sauce
procedure:
Shave the tofu into thin ribbons with a vegetable peeler.
Toss with the spices and crisp in the air fryer or a hot pan.
Mix the yogurt with garlic, lemon and salt.
Fill the pita with the tofu, tomato, lettuce and sauce.

title: Glazed Eggplant on Whipped Feta
procedure:
Roast the eggplant wedges until soft and browned.
Reduce the soy, maple and vinegar with the cornstarch into a glaze.
Whip the feta with the quark until smooth and spread it on the plate.
Pile on the glazed eggplant and finish with mint.

title: Summer Rolls with Marinated Tofu
procedure:
Marinate the tofu strips in soy sauce and sear them.
Soak the noodles and cut the carrot and cucumber into matchsticks.
Soften one sheet of rice paper at a time and roll tightly.
Serve with a dip of soy sauce, lime and crushed peanuts.

title: Falafel
procedure:
Blitz soaked (not cooked) chickpeas with the onion, garlic and herbs.
Season with cumin and salt and bind with a little flour; rest 30 minutes.
Shape into balls and fry or air-fry until deep brown.

title: Tofu Pad Thai
procedure:
Soak the noodles until pliable but not soft.
Fry the tofu until crisp, push it aside and scramble the egg.
Add the noodles with the fish sauce, sugar and lime and toss over high heat.
Finish with spring onion and crushed peanuts.

title: Chana Masala
procedure:
Brown the onion properly, then add the garlic and ginger.
Toast the spices in the oil for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook them down before the chickpeas go in.
Simmer 20 minutes, crushing some chickpeas to thicken it.

title: Coconut Chicken Curry
procedure:
Brown the chicken pieces and set them aside.
Fry the onion, pepper, ginger and curry paste until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, return the chicken and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Shakshuka
procedure:
Soften the onion and pepper, then add the spices.
Pour in the tomatoes and reduce until thick.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until just set.

title: Pan-Seared Steak
procedure:
Take the steak out of the fridge early and pat it dry.
Sear in a very hot pan without moving it, then turn once.
Add the butter, garlic and rosemary and baste for a minute.
Rest it five minutes before slicing.

title: Roast Chicken Thighs with Lemon
procedure:
Toss the potatoes with oil, garlic and rosemary in a tray.
Sit the salted thighs on top, skin side up, with lemon wedges.
Roast 45 minutes at 200 C without turning anything.

title: Baked Salmon with Herbs
procedure:
Sit the fillet on foil with oil, garlic, lemon and herbs.
Bake 15 minutes at 190 C, until it just flakes.
Squeeze over more lemon at the table.

title: Zucchini Frittata
procedure:
Saute the sliced zucchini and onion until they take colour.
Beat the eggs with the parmesan and plenty of salt.
Pour over, cook low until nearly set, then flip or finish under the grill.

title: Pizza Margherita
procedure:
Knead flour, water, salt and a little yeast and let it rise slowly.
Stretch by hand, spread the passata thinly, salt it.
Bake as hot as the oven goes, adding the mozzarella halfway.
Basil and oil go on after it comes out.

title: Lentil and Vegetable Stew
procedure:
Sweat the diced vegetables in the oil.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock and bay leaf.
Simmer 35 minutes until the lentils fall apart at the edges.

title: Lentil Hummus with Sun-dried Tomatoes
procedure:
Blend the cooked lentils with the sun-dried tomatoes and hazelnuts.
Add a splash of soy sauce, the thyme and a little oil.
Grate lemon zest over the top: it carries the flavour without more oil or tahini.

title: Roasted Chickpea Hummus
procedure:
Roast half the chickpeas with garlic powder, both paprikas, oregano, curry and a pinch of chili.
Blend them with the plain chickpeas, the tahini, lemon juice and water.
Finish with grated lemon zest rather than more tahini or oil.

title: Classic Hummus
procedure:
Blend the tahini with the lemon juice and garlic first, until it seizes and loosens.
Add the chickpeas and blend long, adding ice water until it is silky.
Season, pour over oil, grate on lemon zest.

title: Babaganoush
procedure:
Halve the eggplants and roast them cut side down until collapsed.
Peel off the skin and drain the flesh.
Mix, do not blend, with the tahini, lemon and a little oil.

title: Caramelised Onions and Peppers
procedure:
Slice both thinly and start them in oil over medium heat.
When they soften, add the sugar and salt.
Keep going, low, until they are jammy and deep gold.

title: Smoked Paprika Celeriac Chips
procedure:
Cut the celeriac into batons and dry them well.
Toss with oil, rosemary, smoked paprika, pepper and salt.
Roast or air-fry at 200 C until the edges are dark.

title: Peperonata
procedure:
Cook the sliced onion until soft, then add the peppers.
Add the tomato and cook slowly, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season well and finish with basil.

title: Caponata
procedure:
Fry the eggplant cubes until browned and drain them.
Soften the celery and onion, then add the passata, olives and capers.
Return the eggplant, add the vinegar and sugar and cook until sticky.

title: Mashed Potatoes
procedure:
Boil the potatoes whole in salted water, then peel and rice them.
Beat in the butter, then the warm milk.
Season with salt and a scrape of nutmeg.

title: Rosemary Roasted Potatoes
procedure:
Parboil the chunks 8 minutes, drain, and shake them in the pan.
Toss with hot oil, salt, rosemary and unpeeled garlic.
Roast at 210 C for 35 minutes, turning once.

title: Boiled Eggs
procedure:
Lower the eggs into already boiling water.
Seven minutes for a jammy yolk, ten for hard.
Straight into cold water so they peel cleanly.

title: Steamed Broccoli
procedure:
Steam the florets 5 to 6 minutes, until a knife just goes in.
Dress warm with oil, lemon and salt.

title: Boiled Potatoes with Olive Oil
procedure:
Boil the potatoes whole in well-salted water until tender.
Halve them and dress immediately with oil, salt and parsley.

title: Pan-Fried Zucchini with Mint
procedure:
Slice the zucchini into rounds and get the pan properly hot.
Fry in one layer until the undersides are brown, then turn.
Add the garlic at the end and finish with torn mint.

title: Sauteed Spinach with Garlic
procedure:
Warm the sliced garlic in the oil.
Add the spinach in handfuls and toss until just wilted.
Salt and lemon off the heat.

title: Roasted Carrots with Cumin
procedure:
Halve the carrots lengthways and toss with oil, cumin and salt.
Roast 30 minutes at 200 C.
Brush with a little honey for the last five minutes.

title: Green Beans with Garlic
procedure:
Boil the beans in salted water until just tender, then drain.
Finish them in a hot pan with the garlic and chili flakes.

title: Green Salad
procedure:
Wash and dry the leaves properly -- wet leaves will not hold dressing.
Whisk oil, vinegar and salt and toss at the last moment.

title: Tomato and Cucumber Salad
procedure:
Cut the tomatoes into wedges, salt them and let them sit ten minutes.
Add the cucumber and thinly sliced red onion.
Dress with oil and oregano, using the tomato juices.

title: Simple Rice Pilaf
procedure:
Soften the onion, then toast the rinsed rice in the oil.
Add twice its volume of stock and the bay leaf.
Cover, cook 12 minutes, then rest 10 off the heat before forking through.
